question: True or false: in daily life, people high in self-control resist temptations more often than other people do?
answer: False. When Hofmann and colleagues beeped adults at random through a week, those high in self-control reported fewer temptations and used willpower less often, yet reached their goals more. They seemed to arrange life so the fight came up less often: no biscuits in the cupboard, the gym bag already packed by the door.
move: The easiest temptation to beat is the one arranged out of reach.
trap: Crediting their success to resisting, when fewer temptations explain both.
reference: Hofmann, Baumeister, Förster & Vohs, Everyday temptations: an experience sampling study of desire, conflict, and self-control, Journal of Personality and Social Psychology, 2012
